Key responsibilities

Do you want to develop systems that provide real-time execution intelligence to traders? Are you eager to grow into Java and modern cloud deployment on a platform that matters?
  
  
We're looking for a Software Engineer to:
  
  

* develop and maintain our Java alert engines that process real-time trading events (alerting pipelines over AMPS messaging)
* build and improve our CI/CD pipelines and Kubernetes-based deployments (Helm, Ansible, Terraform) for the platform
* contribute across a polyglot codebase spanning Go, JavaScript and kdb/q alongside our core Java services
* write clean, well-tested code and take part in code reviews to keep quality high
* learn the Pulse domain quickly and grow into an owner of engine and deployment components

Your Career Comeback

We are open to applications from career returners. Find out more about our program on ubs.com/careercomeback.

The team

You'll be working in the Pulse Desktop team, part of Agency Trading Algos Crew, in Pune, India. We are a close-knit engineering team building the platform that powers sales traders with execution intelligence via real-time alerting for the Agency Trading business. Our stack runs from Java alert engines and Go distributors, through kdb/q real-time data, to JavaScript front-ends — all deployed on Kubernetes via a fully automated CI/CD pipeline. You'll get broad exposure, real ownership early, and plenty of support to grow.
  
  
Diversity helps us grow, together. That's why we are committed to fostering and advancing diversity, equity, and inclusion. It strengthens our business and brings value to our clients.

Your skills and experience

* solid Java fundamentals — object-oriented design, collections, testing (required)
* genuine eagerness to learn, strong problem-solving ability and intellectual curiosity
* exposure to CI/CD and an interest in build/deployment automation
* familiarity with containers and Kubernetes, ideally on Azure
* working knowledge of databases (SQL / PostgreSQL)
* any exposure to Go, JavaScript or kdb/q is a plus
* a collaborative, team-first approach and clear communication
* You’re curious to explore how AI can improve how we build, deliver, and optimize workflows. You do this with sound judgment – validating outputs and aligning with policies, risk standards, and ethical use.

About us

UBS is a leading and truly global wealth manager and the leading universal bank in Switzerland. We also provide diversified asset management solutions and focused investment banking capabilities. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, UBS is present in more than 50 markets around the globe.
  
We know that great work is never done alone. That’s why we place collaboration at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves. Want to find out more? Visit ubs.com/careers.

We’re dedicated to our craft and passionate about putting our people first, with new challenges, a supportive team, opportunities to grow and flexible working options when possible. Our inclusive culture brings out the best in our employees, wherever they are on their career journey. And we use artificial intelligence (AI) to work smarter and more efficiently. We also recognize that great work is never done alone. That’s why collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves.

### **About** **Clarion Technologies**

Clarion Technologies is an IT services company providing customized software solutions to small & medium businesses globally in a broad spectrum of industries. With 20+ years of expertise in Digital Transformation, we help our customers to improve their business performance significantly. With cutting-edge technology, Agile development, and best coding practices, we are proud to offer one of the most Usable, Reliable, and Secure software solutions. We are certified as a CMMI level 3 company, Great Place to Work in 2019 & Top Software Developers in India by Clutch. -head office in Pune, India, we have two state-of-the-art delivery centers in Pune and Ahmedabad.

### **About** **The Role**

We are seeking a skilled SQL Database Developer with strong expertise in database development, performance tuning, database administration support, and SQL optimization. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, maintaining, and optimizing database solutions that support business-critical applications. This role requires hands-on experience in SQL development, database monitoring, troubleshooting, performance enhancement, and ensuring data integrity, security, and availability across database environments.

### **Job** **Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, and maintain database objects including Tables, Views, Stored Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Packages, and Indexes.
* Develop and optimize SQL and PL/SQL code to support business applications and reporting requirements.
* Implement database schemas, constraints, and rules to ensure data integrity and consistency.
* Identify, troubleshoot, and resolve performance bottlenecks, long-running queries, blocking, and deadlocking issues.
* Develop secure database solutions and ensure protection against vulnerabilities such as SQL Injection.
* Create and maintain complex reports and database-driven solutions for business stakeholders.
* Perform database performance tuning, query optimization, and indexing strategy implementation.
* Participate in requirement gathering and technical discussions to provide effective backend database solutions.
* Monitor database health and performance using tools such as Redgate, Sentry, SQL Profiler, and other monitoring tools.
* Support database migration activities, deployments, and code enhancements.
* Create and maintain databases, tablespaces, indexes, users, roles, permissions, and grants.
* Establish and maintain database backup, recovery, and disaster recovery procedures.
* Perform regular database maintenance activities to ensure operational efficiency and reliability.
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior team members and promote database development best practices.
* Evaluate and recommend database technologies, features, and improvements beyond Microsoft SQL Server.
* Assist clients and internal teams in developing scalable, reliable, and fit-for-purpose database solutions.
* Maintain technical documentation, standards, and operational procedures related to database development and administration.

### **Job** **Requirements**

* 4–6 years of experience in SQL Database Development and Database Management.
* Strong expertise in Microsoft SQL Server database development.
* Proficiency in SQL, T-SQL, and PL/SQL programming.
* Experience in developing Stored Procedures, Functions, Triggers, Views, Packages, and other database objects.
* Strong knowledge of database performance tuning, query optimization, indexing strategies, and execution plan analysis.
* Experience with database monitoring and troubleshooting tools such as Redgate, Sentry, SQL Profiler, and SSMS.
* Hands-on experience in database migration, deployment, backup, recovery, and maintenance activities.
* Good understanding of database security, user management, permissions, and access control.
* Experience with database tools such as SSMS, Profiler, Toad, SSIS, and related technologies.
* Knowledge of relational database concepts, database design principles, and data integrity practices.
* Basic understanding of Database Administration (DBA) activities and operational support.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to work collaboratively with cross-functional teams and stakeholders.
* Database certification is an added advantage.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

title: Lead Secure Software Engineer
description:
Job Description

**About Persistent**

  

We are an AI-led, platform-driven Digital Engineering and Enterprise Modernization partner, combining deep technical expertise and industry experience to help our clients anticipate what’s next. Our offerings and proven solutions create a unique competitive advantage for our clients by giving them the power to see beyond and rise above. We work with many industry-leading organizations across the world, including 18 of the Fortune 50 companies, 7 of the 10 top US banks, 9 of the 10 technology companies, and numerous innovators across the healthcare ecosystem.

  

Our disruptor’s mindset, commitment to client success, and agility to thrive in the dynamic environment have enabled us to sustain our growth momentum. Persistent has been recognized across top industry platforms for innovation, leadership, and inclusion. We have delivered 26 sequential quarters of growth with $487.6M in Q4 FY26 revenue, up 7.8% Q-o-Q and 20.0% Y-o-Y. Our 29,500+ global team members, located in 21 countries, have been instrumental in helping the market leaders transform their industries. We received five awards at the ISG (Information Services Group) Provider Lens™ Awards 2026 and, for the second year in a row, were awarded the Growth Honor of the Year at the Everest Group Elevate 2026.

  

**About Position:**

  

We are seeking an experienced Lead Secure Software Engineer to develop secure software solutions and drive secure coding practices across enterprise application environments. This role focuses on designing resilient software components, identifying and remediating code-level security vulnerabilities, and partnering with development and application security teams to embed security throughout the software development lifecycle. The ideal candidate will possess deep software engineering expertise combined with strong application security knowledge to help build secure, scalable, and maintainable applications.

  

* **Role: Lead Secure Software Engineer**
* **Location: Pune**
* **Experience: 12 to 15 Years**
* **Job Type: Full-Time Employment**
  

**What You'll Do:**

  

* Design and develop secure application features, reusable libraries, frameworks, and security controls for enterprise applications.
* Perform security-focused code reviews and identify vulnerabilities across application codebases.
* Analyze and remediate security findings from Static Application Security Testing (SAST), Software Composition Analysis (SCA), penetration testing, and manual code reviews.
* Collaborate with application security teams to implement secure-by-design development practices.
* Integrate secure coding checks, automated security testing, and quality gates into CI/CD pipelines.
* Develop secure authentication, authorization, session management, and data protection mechanisms.
* Review APIs, microservices, and cloud-native application components for security weaknesses and design flaws.
* Participate in threat modeling exercises and implement remediation strategies for identified risks.
* Create secure coding standards, development guidelines, reference implementations, and developer training materials.
* Mentor development teams on secure coding best practices, OWASP principles, and vulnerability remediation techniques.
* Work closely with architects, developers, DevOps teams, and security stakeholders to ensure security requirements are embedded into software solutions.
* Troubleshoot complex security issues and support incident investigations related to application vulnerabilities.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of secure development frameworks, tools, and engineering practices.
  

**Expertise You'll Bring:**

  

* 12-15 years of experience in Software Development, Secure Software Engineering, Application Security, or Product Security.
* Strong hands-on development experience in one or more enterprise programming languages such as Java, .NET, Python, JavaScript, Go, or Node.js.
* Deep understanding of secure coding principles and common software security vulnerabilities.
* Strong knowledge of OWASP Top 10, CWE/SANS Top 25, secure design principles, and modern application security practices.
* Experience performing manual code reviews and interpreting findings from SAST, DAST, and Software Composition Analysis tools.
* Expertise in authentication, authorization, identity management, session management, encryption, and cryptographic implementations.
* Experience securing REST APIs, GraphQL services, microservices, and cloud-native applications.
* Hands-on experience with application security tools such as Checkmarx, Veracode, Fortify, SonarQube, Snyk, Coverity, Black Duck, or equivalent platforms.
* Familiarity with CI/CD platforms such as Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, GitLab CI/CD, Jenkins, or Harness.
* Understanding of secure software architecture, cloud security, container security, and DevSecOps practices.
* Experience conducting threat modeling and translating security requirements into practical engineering solutions.
* Strong debugging, root cause analysis, and problem-solving capabilities.
* Ability to communicate complex security concepts effectively to engineering and business stakeholders.
* Proven experience mentoring development teams and driving secure development practices at scale.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Certifications such as CSSLP, CISSP, GWAPT, GWEB, Secure Software Practitioner, or equivalent security certifications are highly desirable.
  

**Benefits:**

  

* Competitive salary and benefits package
* Culture focused on talent development with quarterly growth opportunities and company-sponsored higher education and certifications
* Opportunity to work with cutting-edge technologies
* Employee engagement initiatives such as project parties, flexible work hours, and Long Service awards
* Annual health check-ups
* Insurance coverage: group term life, personal accident, and Mediclaim hospitalization for self, spouse, two children, and parents
  

**Values-Driven, People-Centric & Inclusive Work Environment:**

Persistent is dedicated to fostering diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We invite applications from all qualified individuals, including those with disabilities, and regardless of gender or gender preference. We welcome diverse candidates from all backgrounds.

  

* We support hybrid work and flexible hours to fit diverse lifestyles.
* Our office is accessibility-friendly, with ergonomic setups and assistive technologies to support employees with physical disabilities.
* If you are a person with disabilities and have specific requirements, please inform us during the application process or at any time during your employment
  

**Let's unleash your full potential at Persistent -** **persistent.com/careers**

  

***"Persistent is an Equal Opportunity Employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind."***

title: Senior Mendix Developer
description:
We are seeking an experienced **Senior Mendix Developer** with strong hands-on expertise in low-code application development, enterprise application architecture, integrations, and end-to-end solution delivery. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, developing, enhancing, and maintaining scalable, secure, and high-performance applications using the Mendix platform.

The successful candidate will collaborate with business stakeholders, solution architects, product owners, and cross-functional engineering teams to translate complex business requirements into robust technical solutions. This role requires strong proficiency in **Mendix Studio Pro, domain modeling, microflows, nanoflows, application security, API integrations, and application lifecycle management**, along with the ability to provide technical guidance and support high-quality project delivery.

**Key Responsibilities:-**

* **Solution Design & Development:** Design, develop, and maintain scalable enterprise-grade applications using Mendix Studio Pro and low-code development methodologies.
* **Requirements Analysis:** Collaborate with business stakeholders and product owners to understand functional requirements and translate them into technical specifications and solution designs.
* **Mendix Development:** Build and optimize domain models, microflows, nanoflows, pages, reusable components, and application logic in accordance with Mendix development best practices.
* **Enterprise Integrations:** Develop and maintain integrations with REST/SOAP APIs, relational databases, and external enterprise applications.
* **Application Security:** Implement appropriate authentication, authorization, access controls, and data security measures to ensure secure application delivery.
* **Performance Optimization:** Analyze application performance, troubleshoot bottlenecks, and implement improvements to scalability, responsiveness, and reliability.
* **Quality Engineering:** Conduct code reviews, unit and integration testing, defect analysis, debugging, and root-cause investigation.
* **Application Lifecycle Management:** Support version control, deployment management, environment configuration, CI/CD pipelines, and production releases.
* **Production Support:** Monitor application health, resolve production issues, and deliver enhancements and corrective fixes as required.
* **Agile Collaboration:** Participate in sprint planning, backlog refinement, technical discussions, estimation, and delivery reviews.
* **Technical Leadership:** Mentor junior developers, promote coding standards, review technical solutions, and contribute to architectural and implementation decisions.
* **Documentation:** Maintain technical specifications, integration documentation, deployment procedures, and application support guides.

**Mandatory Skills & Experience:-**

* 6–8 years of relevant professional experience, including substantial hands-on experience in Mendix application development.
* Strong practical expertise in **Mendix Studio Pro** and the development of enterprise-grade low-code applications.
* Proven experience across the complete Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), from requirement analysis and solution design to deployment and production support.
* Strong understanding of Mendix domain modeling, microflows, nanoflows, data entities, associations, and application logic.
* Experience designing and implementing secure, maintainable, and reusable Mendix application components.
* Hands-on experience integrating Mendix applications with REST/SOAP APIs, relational databases, and external systems.
* Knowledge of application security, role-based access control, data protection, and secure development practices.
* Familiarity with Agile/Scrum methodologies, source control, testing practices, and CI/CD processes.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work effectively in a collaborative, hybrid delivery environment.

**Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills:-**

* Mendix Advanced or Expert certification.
* Experience with cloud-based deployments, environment management, application monitoring, and performance tuning.
* Familiarity with Java, JavaScript, or other technologies used to extend Mendix capabilities.
* Experience working on enterprise-scale applications, complex integrations, or multi-team delivery programs.
* Exposure to automated testing, DevOps practices, and continuous delivery pipelines.
* Experience providing technical mentorship and contributing to solution architecture decisions.

**Key Success Metrics:-**

* Timely delivery of reliable, scalable, and high-quality Mendix applications.
* Application performance, stability, security, and maintainability.
* Quality of integrations and effectiveness in resolving technical issues.
* Compliance with development standards, testing practices, and release processes.
* Effective collaboration with stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
* Contribution to team productivity, technical capability, and continuous improvement.

Pay: ₹2,800,000.00 - ₹3,200,000.00 per year

description:
**Experience: 2–3 years Location: Pune**

**Job Summary:**

We are seeking a hands-on Embedded C / Wireless Firmware Developer with 2 to 3 years of experience who bridges the gap between hardware and software. In this role, you will be responsible for bringing up **microcontrollers, writing clean, low-level Embedded C code,** and **developing wireless communication pipelines**. * Platform Specialization: Develop firmware using STM32 (HAL/LL or bare-metal) and ESP32 (ESP-IDF) ecosystems.
* Peripheral Interfacing: Write and configure drivers for low-level protocols including SPI, I2C, UART, and GPIOs.
* Lab Debugging: Use test equipment such as logic analyzers, oscilloscopes, and JTAG/SWD debuggers to isolate firmware bugs from hardware faults.

**Required Technical Skills:**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Electronics & Communication (ECE), Computer Engineering, or a related field.
* Experience: 2 to 3 years of professional experience in embedded systems development.
* Language Proficiency: Expert knowledge of Embedded C (memory management, pointers, registers, and interrupt handling).
* Hardware Architectures: Direct, hands-on experience with STM32 (ARM Cortex-M) and ESP32 (Xtensa/RISC-V) microcontrollers.
* Wireless Protocols: Practical exposure to BLE concepts (GAP, GATT, Advertising, Services, and Characteristics).
* Hardware Literacy: Ability to interpret electronic circuit schematics and datasheets.
* Development Tools: Familiarity with Git, STM32CubeIDE, VS Code (PlatformIO / ESP-IDF extension), and GCC toolchains.

**Your Impact**
---------------

We are seeking an experienced Senior Installation Developer with 4–7 years of professional software development experience to design, develop, test, and maintain reliable software installation and deployment solutions across Windows, Linux, and containerized environments.

  
  

The ideal candidate will have strong programming and problem-solving skills, solid knowledge of installation and deployment technologies, and a strong understanding of software development practices. The candidate should be able to independently design and implement installation solutions, troubleshoot complex issues, and collaborate effectively with development, QA, DevOps, and other cross-functional teams in an Agile development environment.

  
  

The successful candidate should also be able to effectively leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve development efficiency, accelerate coding and troubleshooting, enhance testing and documentation, and improve software quality while applying appropriate engineering judgment to validate AI-generated solutions.

  
  

* Design, develop, test, and maintain software installation and deployment solutions for Windows, Linux, and containerized environments.

* Develop and maintain installation tools, automation, and scripts using C#, C++, PowerShell, and Bash.
* Apply sound software design and development practices to ensure installation solutions are maintainable, extensible, testable, and reliable.
* Participate in the full software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, technical design, implementation, code review, testing, deployment, troubleshooting, and maintenance.
* Develop and maintain automated tests and validation processes to improve installation quality and prevent regressions.
* Leverage AI-assisted development tools to improve efficiency in coding, scripting, debugging, testing, code review, troubleshooting, refactoring, and technical documentation.
* Evaluate and validate AI-generated code and technical recommendations to ensure correctness, security, performance, maintainability, and compliance with established engineering standards.
* Collaborate with developers, QA, DevOps, architects, and other cross-functional teams to define installation and deployment requirements, designs, and strategies.
* Work with container technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes, to support modern application and deployment environments.
* Integrate installation and deployment processes with version control systems such as Git and Perforce and automated CI/CD pipelines.
* Support installation and configuration requirements involving SQL and NoSQL database technologies.
* Participate in technical design reviews, code reviews, and knowledge-sharing activities within the development team.
* Troubleshoot, debug, and resolve complex installation and deployment issues through effective root-cause analysis and sustainable solutions.
* Follow Agile development practices and established software engineering standards to deliver high-quality solutions in a timely manner.
* Identify opportunities to leverage AI, automation, and modern development tools to simplify installation and deployment processes and improve engineering productivity.

**What You'll Need**
--------------------

* 4–7 years of professional software development experience, with experience in software installation, deployment, build, or related technologies.
* Strong programming and coding skills, with the ability to independently design, develop, test, debug, and maintain installation and deployment solutions.
* Strong proficiency in C# and/or C++, with experience using PowerShell and Bash for scripting and automation.
* Strong knowledge of Windows and/or Linux operating systems, including software installation, configuration, upgrade, and deployment concepts.
* Solid experience with Windows Installer technology, InstallShield, or comparable software installation and packaging technologies.
* Solid understanding of software engineering principles, object-oriented design, software design patterns, and maintainable software development practices.
* Strong understanding of the software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, design, development, testing, deployment, and maintenance.
* Experience with software testing practices, including unit testing, integration testing, automated testing, debugging, and defect resolution.
* Experience leveraging AI-assisted software development tools to improve coding, debugging, testing, code review, troubleshooting, documentation, and overall development efficiency.
* Ability to critically evaluate and validate AI-generated code and recommendations, applying sound software engineering principles and appropriate human oversight.
* Hands-on experience with container technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes.
* Experience with CI/CD pipelines, build automation, and modern software deployment practices.
* Experience with version control systems, such as Git and Perforce.
* Familiarity with SQL and NoSQL database technologies and their installation and configuration requirements.
* Experience working within an Agile software development environment.
* Strong analytical, debugging, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate technical issues, designs, and solutions.
* Strong collaboration and teamwork skills, with the ability to work effectively with development teams and cross-functional stakeholders.

**About the Role:**

ComScore is a leading cross platform audience measurement company. We measure what matters to make audiences and advertising more valuable. We collect and process billions of events each day, have 10s of petabytes online and each month our processes read nearly an exabyte. We use this capability to provide our clients with unlocked insights into their data.

We are looking for a Software Engineer to join our Product Data Engineering organization. This job involves designing and maintaining big data web & engineering solutions capable of running efficiently and robustly at petabyte scale.

At Comscore, we’re pioneering the future of cross-platform media measurement, arming organizations with the insights they need to make decisions with confidence. Central to this aim are our people who work together to simplify the complex on behalf of our clients & partners. Though our roles and skills are varied, we’re united by our commitment to five underlying values: Integrity, Velocity, Accountability, Teamwork, and Servant Leadership. title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
**Senior Software Engineer- (Data Engineering, AWS & MLOPs)**

**Core skills:** AWS, Snowflake, data ingestion, data transformation, SQL, MLOps and Python

**Location: Pune, India (Work from home)**

  

**Role Overview**

We are seeking a Senior Data Engineer to design, build and operate scalable data pipelines and analytical solutions using AWS and Snowflake. This role will integrate data from enterprise applications, APIs, databases and files, transforming it into reliable datasets for analytics, reporting and AI/ML use cases. The ideal candidate combines strong engineering skills with experience delivering secure, reliable and cost-effective data platforms in production.

  

**You will be responsible for:**

* Design and maintain batch and incremental data ingestion pipelines from APIs, relational databases, SaaS applications and file sources.
* Build AWS ingestion solutions using services such as Amazon S3, AWS Glue, Lambda, IAM and Step Functions.
* Develop Snowflake data models and transformation pipelines using SQL, Python, dbt or equivalent tools.
* Implement Bronze, Silver and Gold layers within a medallion architecture, with clear data contracts and lineage.
* Process structured and semi-structured data, including JSON, CSV and Parquet.
* Implement change data capture, incremental loading, deduplication, schema evolution and historical data management.
* Integrate datasets across systems using consistent business keys, reference mappings and transformation rules.
* Build data quality checks, reconciliation controls, monitoring, alerting and recovery procedures.
* Optimize Snowflake queries, warehouse usage and storage to improve performance and control costs.
* Implement access controls, encryption, secrets management and data protection requirements.
* Establish automated testing, CI/CD and repeatable deployment practices for data pipelines.
* Troubleshoot production issues, perform root cause analysis and improve pipeline reliability.
* Collaborate with analysts, data scientists, architects and business stakeholders to translate requirements into technical solutions.
* Maintain technical documentation and provide engineering guidance through design and code reviews.

  

**You should apply if you have:**

* 8+ years of professional experience in data engineering, data warehousing, ETL/ELT development or related roles.
* Strong hands-on experience with AWS and Snowflake in production environments.
* Advanced SQL skills, including complex transformations, analytical functions and query optimization.
* Strong Python skills for API integrations, data processing, automation and error handling.
* Experience building ingestion pipelines with pagination, authentication, rate limiting, retries and checkpointing.
* Experience with Snowflake capabilities such as stages, storage integrations, COPY INTO, Snowpipe, Streams and Tasks.
* Experience with transformation frameworks such as dbt or equivalent SQL-based tooling.
* Experience with orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, AWS Step Functions or equivalent platforms.
* Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, slowly changing dimensions and incremental processing.
* Experience implementing data quality, observability, lineage and operational support practices.
* Proficiency with Git, code reviews and CI/CD.
* Strong problem-solving, communication and stakeholder collaboration skills.

  

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience preparing and managing datasets for AI/ML, including feature engineering and training and inference pipelines.
* Familiarity with MLOps, including experiment tracking, model versioning, deployment, monitoring and retraining workflows.
* Experience with tools such as Amazon SageMaker, MLflow, Snowpark or equivalent platforms.
* Familiarity with model drift, data drift and reproducibility.
* Experience supporting generative AI applications, embeddings, vector search or retrieval-augmented generation.
* Experience with streaming technologies such as Amazon Kinesis or Apache Kafka.
* Experience with infrastructure as code using Terraform or AWS CloudFormation.
* AWS, Snowflake or relevant data engineering certifications.

  

**About Convera**

Convera is the largest non-bank B2B cross-border payments company in the world. Formerly Western Union Business Solutions, we leverage decades of industry expertise and technology-led payment solutions to deliver smarter money movements to our customers – helping them capture more value with every transaction. Convera serves more than 30,000 customers ranging from small business owners to enterprise treasurers to educational institutions to financial institutions to law firms to NGOs. Our teams care deeply about the value we bring to our customers, which makes Convera a rewarding place to work. This is an exciting time for our organization as we build our team with growth-minded, result-oriented people who are looking to move fast in an innovative environment. As a truly global company with employees in over 20 countries, we are passionate about diversity; we seek and celebrate people from different backgrounds, lifestyles, and unique points of view. We want to work with the best people and ensure we foster a culture of inclusion and belonging.

  

**We offer an abundance of competitive perks and benefits including:**

* Competitive salary
* Opportunity to earn an annual bonus.
* Great career growth and development opportunities in a global organization
* A flexible approach to work

There are plenty of amazing opportunities at Convera for talented, creative problem solvers who never settle for good enough and are looking to transform Business to Business payments. Apply now if you're ready to unleash your potential.

Medallia is the pioneer and market leader in Experience Management. Our award-winning SaaS platform, Medallia Experience Cloud, leads the market in the management of experiences, insights, and actions for candidates, customers, employees, patients, and residents alike.

We believe that every experience is a memory that can last a lifetime. Experiences shape the way people feel about a company. And they greatly influence how likely people are to advocate, contribute, and stay. At Medallia, we are committed to creating a world where organizations are loved by their customers and their employees.

We empower exceptional people to create extraordinary experiences together.

Bring your whole self.

The Role and Team

At Medallia, our Nexus Collection & Data Platform team builds and operates the critical backend services that power how surveys are executed, distributed, processed, and collected across Nexus, Medallia’s next-generation experience management platform.

Our systems sit at the core of Nexus’s data platform and support large-scale, highly available workloads across many enterprise customers. The team owns services and capabilities related to survey execution, distribution, response processing, webhooks, messaging integrations, and the streaming pipelines that turn raw collection events into reliable, reportable data.

As Nexus continues to scale, we are evolving these systems to improve performance, reliability, scalability, and operational efficiency while building out key parts of the platform from the ground up on a modern, cloud-native stack.

We are looking for a Staff Software Engineer who enjoys solving challenging backend and distributed systems problems, working with high-throughput streaming services, and building reliable software that operates at enterprise scale. You will work closely with experienced engineers, Product Management, QA, and other platform teams to design and deliver capabilities that directly impact how millions of surveys and responses are processed across Nexus.  
  
This role is based remotely in Pune. Candidates for this position are required to reside within the Pune metropolitan area. Relocation support is not available at this time.

Responsibilities:  

* Drive resolution on open, cross-cutting architectural questions — Nexus has several live ones at any given time (e.g., which store owns a given workload and why, how a materialization strategy should be chosen and validated, how a new enrichment type should integrate without violating existing invariants). You're expected to drive these to a documented, defensible decision — not just have an opinion on them.
* Own the integrity of the platform's core data invariants across teams — multi-tenant isolation via the composite entity key model, the rule that enrichments never rewrite interaction data, and that row-level access is enforced on views rather than scattered through application logic. When a new feature threatens one of these, you're the engineer who catches it before it ships.
* Design the pipeline and schema evolution patterns other teams build against — e.g., how a dataset schema can evolve without migrations or downtime, how a new interaction type gets onboarded, how an enrichment's output reaches reporting without duplicating or destabilizing existing views.  
  Lead technical design for major cross-team initiatives — examples at this scale: extending the platform to ingest data originating from Medallia's existing products (MEC) alongside Nexus-native data, designing how AI agents (survey-building assistants, conversational feedback collection) integrate with the core data model via MCP/A2A without becoming a second, inconsistent source of truth.
* Evaluate and make build-vs-buy and store-selection decisions with real stakes — e.g., assessing whether a given workload belongs on a relational store, a wide-column store, or an OLAP engine, and what the actual operational and consistency trade-offs are, backed by a POC or benchmark rather than a hunch.
* Mentor senior and mid-level engineers on distributed systems design, data modeling for multi-tenant correctness, and how to reason about trade-offs in a system where "simple and wrong" fails silently and expensively.
* Represent engineering in architecture and design reviews across team boundaries, and be a primary author of the architecture documentation the rest of the organization builds against.
* Get hands-on when it matters — staff-level scope doesn't mean stepping back from code. You'll personally build the hardest, highest-leverage pieces of a cross-cutting initiative, especially where the design risk is too high to hand off before it's proven out.
* Improve how the platform is operated at scale — reliability, observability, and incident response patterns that work across both the application and data layers, not just within one service's boundary.
* Use AI-assisted development tools responsibly, and set the bar for how your teams evaluate AI-generated code for correctness, security, and long-term maintainability.

Qualifications:

Minimum Qualifications:

* 8+ years of professional software engineering experience, with a track record of technical leadership beyond your own individual contributions — driving decisions, designs, or initiatives that other engineers and teams built on top of.
* Deep expertise in distributed systems — you can reason rigorously about consistency models, failure modes, data consistency guarantees, and the real trade-offs behind an architectural decision, not just the vocabulary.
* Strong backend engineering background, ideally spanning more than one language/stack (e.g., Java and TypeScript/Node.js, or equivalent) — this role operates across Nexus Core and the Data Platform, and needs to be credible in both.
* Demonstrated experience with event-driven and streaming architectures (Kafka or equivalent, plus a stream processor such as Flink, Spark Streaming, or Kafka Streams).
* Deep experience with relational and/or wide-column data stores at scale, including schema design for systems that can't tolerate downtime or destructive changes.
* Proven experience designing for multi-tenant SaaS correctness — tenant isolation, authorization models, and the discipline required when a design mistake doesn't just cause a bug, it causes a data leak between customers.
* A track record of making and defending hard technical trade-off decisions in writing — RFCs, design docs, or equivalent — and bringing skeptical stakeholders to alignment.
* Experience mentoring senior engineers and influencing technical direction without direct management authority.
* Excellent written and verbal communication — at this level, your technical judgment is only as useful as your ability to convey it clearly to engineers, product, and leadership.

Preferred Qualifications:

* Experience designing row-level or policy-based authorization systems, especially ones enforced at the data/view layer rather than purely in application code.
* Experience with identity resolution systems — matching, merging, and the operational cost of getting profile/entity resolution wrong at scale.
* Experience integrating LLM-based agents or tools into a production platform, especially using protocols like MCP (Model Context Protocol) or agent-to-agent (A2A) coordination.
* Experience leading a platform migration or hybrid-integration effort — e.g., bringing a legacy system's data into a new platform without forcing customers through a disruptive migration.
* Background in customer experience management, survey platforms, or voice-of-customer systems.
* Experience as a technical lead on a greenfield platform build, with scars to show for the early architectural bets that worked and the ones that didn't.  
    
  At Medallia, we celebrate diversity and recognize the value it brings to our customers and employees. Medallia is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age (40 and over), disability, genetic information, veteran status or military service, or any other status protected by state or local law. Individuals with a disability who need an accommodation to apply please contact us at ApplicantAccessibility@medallia.com. For information regarding how Medallia collects and uses personal information, please review our Privacy Policies. Applications will be accepted for 30 days from the date this role was posted or until the role has been filled.

Job Description

We are seeking a **Staff Software Engineer** to drive technical execution and contribute to the ongoing evolution of our platform. In this role, you will take technical ownership of core platform components, translate ambiguous feature requirements into clean, scalable software, and leverage AI-first development workflows to accelerate delivery and elevate code quality. **What You’ll Do**

**Drive End-to-End Feature Delivery:** Take ownership of complex feature sets and components. Break down ambiguous requirements into execution-ready tasks, estimate work accurately, and reliably deliver high-quality solutions end-to-end.

**Implement AI-First Engineering Practices:** Apply high AI tool fluency and prompt engineering to streamline daily development. Rigorously review and validate AI-generated code to prevent security gaps, logic defects, and hallucinations before committing.

**Design for Extensibility & Modularity:** Propose clean feature designs and API interfaces using standard architectural patterns. Write modular, testable code that gracefully balances performance, reliability, and maintainability.

**Identity & Access Security Domain:** Experience with IAM, PAM, IGA, or Secrets Management platforms.

**Modern Frontend & Quality Tooling:** Fluency in TypeScript along with automated testing frameworks such as Jest, Playwright, or JMeter for load/stress testing.

**DevOps & Observability Ecosystems:** Practical experience with CI/CD pipelines, feature flagging tools, and modern monitoring/logging frameworks.

**Context Engineering & Retrieval:** Experience structuring codebase documentation and architecture for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and reusable prompt templating.

By combining hands-on technical execution, modular design, and AI-first workflows, you will turn product goals into secure, scalable, and maintainable capabilities. Your success will be measured by the reliability of the software you deliver, the operational health of your services, and your ability to elevate the velocity and engineering standards of your immediate team.

**Qualifications**

**Full-Stack Proficiency:** Hands-on experience building enterprise-grade applications using the MEAN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, Angular, Node.js).

**AI Tooling & Code Verification:** Proficiency with AI-assisted development tools and prompt engineering, paired with peer-review rigor to verify AI outputs for correctness, safety, and security.

**Feature Design & System Refactoring:** Solid foundation in designing clean APIs, refactoring component code bases, and applying standard design patterns for long-term maintainability.

**Operational Ownership & Testing:** Strong debugging skills with experience in writing robust tests (unit/integration), participating in RCA processes, and resolving production issues.

description:
For more than 30 years, SonicWall has delivered a partner-first unified cybersecurity portfolio that helps SMBs, MSPs, and IT teams consolidate network security, endpoint security, security service edge (SSE), and threat response across hybrid environments. By bringing connected technology, real-time threat intelligence, automation, and expert services together, SonicWall helps organizations simplify security operations, achieve better security outcomes, and lower total cost of ownership. Backed by a global ecosystem of more than 17,000 partners, SonicWall delivers enterprise-grade protection built for SMB and mid-market realities.

For more information, visit www.sonicwall.com or follow us on X, LinkedIn, Facebook, and Instagram.

**About the Role**

We are seeking a **Principal Engineer** to lead the architecture and development of **Deep Packet Inspection (DPI) and SSL/TLS Decryption** engines for our NGFW appliance and virtual firewall product lines. You will drive the design of high-throughput L7 inspection and threat prevention capabilities — including Anti-Virus, Anti-Spyware, IPS, Content Filtering, and Application Control — at scale across 10G–100G+ deployments.

**Responsibilities**

* Architect and evolve the **DPI engine** for multi-gigabit stream-based L7 traffic inspection on NGFW appliances.
* Lead design of the **SSL/TLS decryption pipeline** to enable security services inspection over encrypted traffic.
* Define integration strategy between the decryption layer and downstream **security services** (AV, IPS, Anti-Spyware, Content Filtering, Application Control).
* Drive **hardware acceleration** strategy for cryptographic and pattern-matching workloads.
* Champion **security hardening** practices and ensure compliance with modern cryptographic standards.
* Own **architecture reviews**, author technical specifications, define performance benchmarks, and mentor senior engineers.

**Requirements**

* **10+ years** of C/C++ experience in high-performance networking, packet processing, or L7 security engines on NGFW or carrier-grade platforms.
* Strong expertise in **SSL/TLS internals** — TLS 1.2/1.3, PKI, certificate management, and OpenSSL/BoringSSL.
* Hands-on experience building or optimizing **DPI or security service engines** (AV, IPS, Content Filtering, or Application Control) on commercial NGFW platforms.
* Proficiency in **multi-core, low-latency C/C++** programming — concurrency, memory optimization, and zero-copy techniques.
* Strong **debugging and profiling** skills across complex, multi-threaded networking environments.

**Nice to Have**

* Familiarity with NGFW security services from leading industry vendors.
* Exposure to modern encrypted protocol standards (HTTP/3, QUIC, DoH, ECH/ESNI).
* Experience with virtual or cloud firewall performance tuning.
* Hands-on with network traffic generation and testing tools (Spirent, IXIA, TRex).

title: Manager, Software Engineering | Data & AI Platform
description:
**Our Purpose**

*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**

Manager, Software Engineering | Data & AI PlatformWho is Mastercard?  
  
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments industry. Our mission is to connect and power an inclusive, digital economy that benefits everyone, everywhere by making transactions safe, simple, smart, and accessible. Using secure data and networks, partnerships and passion, our innovations and solutions help individuals, financial institutions, governments, and businesses realize their greatest potential.  
  
Our decency quotient, or DQ, drives our culture and everything we do inside and outside of our company. With connections across more than 210 countries and territories, we are building a sustainable world that unlocks priceless possibilities for all.  
  
Overview  
  
Data Foundations, part of Business & Market Insights, solves shared data problems for Mastercard's analytics products: secure customer data exchange, consistent business definitions and metrics, reference datasets, data quality and AI-assisted customer data onboarding. Engineering and product set direction together, and we own outcomes, not just delivery. Where enterprise platforms fit, we reuse and shape them. Where there is a shared gap, we solve it once.  
  
We are looking for a Manager, Software Engineering to lead a growing Pune-based team that builds and runs shared data capabilities. Your first challenge is reliable ingestion of customer and third-party data, while moving established pipelines from manual effort to cloud automation. You will spend 40-50% of your time hands-on. In your first few months you will baseline what the team runs, close the riskiest gaps and deliver the first measurable cut in manual onboarding work.  
  
Role  
  

* Partner with product management to understand users, shape scope and priorities, and share accountability for outcomes.
* Manage and develop engineers: set goals, give regular feedback, run performance reviews, and help attract and grow talent as the team expands.
* Own the team's technical direction, reviewing designs, pipeline plans and code, and spend 40-50% of your time hands-on where it counts most.
* Own execution across new development and production support, reducing operational load by automating, improving or retiring pipelines.
* Set and uphold standards for testing, release, data quality and security, with clear owners, monitoring and service-level objectives for production services; lead major incidents through to root cause.
* Plan capacity across employees and contractors, hold vendors to clear deliverables, and work with business operations on customer onboarding.
* Communicate progress, risks and decisions to senior leaders, and help the team use AI tools where they genuinely improve speed or quality.

  
All About You  
  

* Experience managing engineers, including performance management and career development.
* Strong product judgement and a record of shaping what is built, not just delivering it.
* Experience running and improving production data pipelines, including moving legacy workloads to the cloud.
* Recent hands-on experience with Databricks and AWS or comparable cloud data platforms.
* Good knowledge of batch processing, data quality and data governance.
* Clear communication across global technical and senior audiences.

  
Desirable:  

* Experience exchanging data with external customers or partners, including secure transfer and access control.
* Experience with SQL Server, Hadoop or other platforms being migrated.
* Experience in payments, financial services or a regulated data environment.

  
Corporate Security Responsibility  
  
Every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security. All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and therefore, it is expected that the successful candidate for this position must:  
  

* Abide by Mastercard's security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard's guidelines.

**Our Mission**

At Palo Alto Networks®, we’re united by a shared mission—to protect our digital way of life. We thrive at the intersection of innovation and impact, solving real-world problems with cutting-edge technology and bold thinking. Here, everyone has a voice, and every idea counts. If you are passionate about solving real-world problems and ideating beside the best and the brightest, we invite you to join us!

We believe collaboration thrives in person. That’s why most of our teams work from the office full time, with flexibility when it’s needed. This model supports real-time problem-solving, stronger relationships, and the kind of precision that drives great outcomes.

**Job Summary**

  
  

Job Description

We are seeking a Senior Staff Software Engineer to advance the architectural evolution and technical direction of our platform. In this role, you will tackle high-ambiguity technical challenges, set the engineering vision, and pioneer AI-first development workflows to accelerate feature delivery and elevate software quality. You will take end-to-end ownership of critical system capabilities—designing for scale, optimizing cycle times, and establishing resilient security and operational patterns.
  
**What You’ll Do**

**Drive End-to-End Feature Delivery:** Take complete ownership of complex, end-to-end feature delivery by breaking down work, managing commitments, and systematically reducing cycle time and rework.

**Lead AI-First Engineering Practices:** Apply high AI tool fluency and prompt/context engineering to design AI-assisted workflows across the agentic SDLC. Rigorously evaluate AI-generated code to prevent hallucinations, security gaps, and logic defects.

**Architect for Scale & Extensibility:** Design clear system interfaces and extensible logic that minimize maintainer toil, gracefully handling performance, reliability, and scale trade-offs.

**Practice Defensive & Secure Engineering:** Enforce defensive coding practices across edge conditions, limits, and complex authorization paths to reduce defect escape rates.

**Simplify Workflows & Enhance User Experience:** Partner with PM and Design to translate product requirements into intuitive code, using prototypes and telemetry to simplify complex user flows and reduce friction.

**Ensure Production Service Excellence:** Act as a champion for service health by driving root cause analysis (RCA) on production incidents, reducing MTTR, and implementing durable fixes.

**Foster Team Capability & Knowledge Sharing:** Run technical experiments, share modern design patterns, document tribal knowledge, and author "RAG-ready" technical notes to onboard and uplevel engineering peers.

  

**Nice to Have**

**Identity & Access Security Domain:** Direct experience with IAM, PAM, IGA, or Secrets Management platforms.

**Modern Frontend & Quality Tooling:** Fluency in TypeScript along with automated testing frameworks such as Jest, Playwright, or JMeter for load and stress testing.

**DevOps & Observability Ecosystems:** Practical experience with progressive delivery, CI/CD pipelines, feature flagging tools, and modern monitoring frameworks.

**Context Engineering & Retrieval:** Experience structuring codebase documentation and architecture for Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) and reusable prompt templating.

  

**Impact**  
As a Senior Staff Software Engineer, you will serve as a primary pillar of our technical strategy and engineering culture. By combining deep technical expertise with AI-first workflows, you will transform complex, ambiguous visions into secure, scalable, and highly performant platform capabilities. Your impact will be measured not only by the durability and reliability of the software you ship, but also by the accelerated velocity and heightened capability of the engineering teams with which you collaborate.

**Qualifications**

**Qualifications**

**Full-Stack Mastery:** Deep hands-on experience building enterprise-grade applications using the MEAN stack (MongoDB, Express.js, Angular, Node.js).

**Cloud Infrastructure Leadership:** Proven track record architecting, deploying, and operating scalable solutions within the AWS ecosystem.

**AI Tooling & Output Verification:** Expertise in prompt and context engineering, utilizing AI tools within software development while exercising peer-review rigor to verify AI outputs for correctness and security.

**Navigating Ambiguity:** Demonstrated ability to remain highly productive through fluid requirements, adapting technical tactics while maintaining alignment with business goals.

**System Design & Extensibility:** Strong foundation in designing clean APIs, refactoring complex code bases, and making explicit architectural trade-offs for long-term scalability.

**Production & Operational Ownership:** Extensive experience debugging complex production services, driving RCAs, and implementing systemic prevention mechanisms.

**Cross-Functional Influence:** Skilled at aligning with PM, Design, and engineering partners,

writing clear RFCs, and mentoring teams without needing formal authority.

**Our Commitment**

We’re trailblazers that dream big, take risks, and challenge cybersecurity’s status quo. It’s simple: we can’t accomplish our mission without diverse teams innovating, together.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Platform Services, Pune
description:
**About Platform Services**

Platform Services as a group provides common infrastructure, managed services, and product development and release services to support Bloomberg's application development. The group has about a thousand team members spread across all of Bloomberg's global offices focused on Application and Middleware Frameworks, Database Solutions, Connectivity, Security, Cloud Native Compute and Storage Services. Our mission is to provide Bloomberg developers with a standard, scalable, managed and compliant platform experience.

  
  

**About the Teams**

*DataLayer Platform*

DataLayer is the high-performance library used to build reactive transformations of data in the Bloomberg Terminal. From simple sorting and filtering, to complex multi-level aggregations and the Excel-like expression evaluation engine, Datalayer is the engine that powers almost every grid or table of data in the Bloomberg Terminal.

The newly created DataLayer Platform team in Pune will take ownership of embedding the DataLayer into Bloomberg runtimes, providing seamless integration with the Bloomberg Terminal and backend services. This will require the team to work closely with other DataLayer teams as well as multiple infrastructure teams to ensure that DataLayer works as efficiently and performant as possible in those runtimes.

  
  

**We’ll trust you to:**

* Have an eye for detail and an interest in working on the complex challenges of large-scale distributed systems.
* Bring a strong understanding of working with highly multi-threaded and asynchronous programming environments
* Understand how to make changes to a live production system safely and responsibly, without causing any impact to our users
* Communicate clearly and effectively and share our values toward software development and professional collaboration.
  

  

**You'll need to have:**

* 5+ years of total software developer experience in C++
* A Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, similar field of study or equivalent work experience
* Strong understanding of object-oriented design, data structures, multi-threading, and algorithms
* Experience with designing, developing and managing large-scale service-oriented systems
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills
* A self-starter approach with a strong sense of ownership
  

  

**We'd love to see:**

* Experience working on complex infrastructure systems under continuous use
* Experience in performance optimizations, passion to write performance-critical code
* Experience in Python or JavaScript/TypeScript
* Experience in multithreading
* Exposure to multiple phases of the software development life-cycle
  

  

**What’s in it for you:**

The platform services teams are associated with many of Bloomberg's collaborative efforts, with a lot of us involved in both internal and external technical communities, conferences and organizations. We also have relationships with many other infrastructure teams across Bloomberg and numerous open-source projects used at all levels of our software development and deployment stack.

  
  

**If this sounds like you:**

Apply if you think we're a good match. We'll get in touch to let you know what the next steps are, but in the meantime, feel free to have a look at this:

Introducing our Pune Engineering teams

Bloomberg Engineering

Technology at Bloomberg

Learn more about our Pune office and benefits

  

Discover what makes Bloomberg unique - watch our podcast series for an inside look at our culture, values, and the people behind our success.

Examples of reasonable adjustment/accommodation include but are not limited to making a change to the application process or work procedures, providing documents in an alternate format or using specialized equipment. **Location** : Hinjewadi, Pune (Work from office)

**Experience** : Minimum 8 years of experience in Siemens Opcenter MES & System Integration

**Position Summary**

We are seeking an experienced Opcenter MES System Developer to design, develop, configure, integrate, and support Siemens Opcenter MES solutions across manufacturing operations. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience in manufacturing requirements into scalable MES applications and will be responsible for both system design and software development.

**Key Responsibilities**

\* Design and develop Siemens Opcenter MES solutions based on manufacturing and business requirements.

\* Configure and customize Opcenter MES modules, workflows, screens, business rules, and reports.

\* Develop integrations between Opcenter MES and ERP, PLM, automation, equipment, warehouse, quality, and other enterprise systems.

\* Design application architecture, data models, interfaces, and technical specifications.

\* Develop and maintain APIs, web services, database procedures, and integration components.

\* Analyze existing manufacturing processes and recommend opportunities for standardization and automation.

\* Participate in requirements gathering, solution design, development, testing, deployment, and production support.

\* Troubleshoot system issues and perform root-cause analysis.

\* Develop technical documentation, configuration guides, test plans, and support procedures.

\* Collaborate with global manufacturing sites to implement consistent MES processes.

\* Support data migration, system upgrades, validation, and release management.

\* Follow software development, cybersecurity, change management, and IT governance standards.

\* Provide technical guidance to project teams, business users, and other developers.

**Required Qualifications**

\* Demonstrated experience designing and developing manufacturing execution systems.

\* Hands-on experience with Siemens Opcenter MES or a comparable MES platform.

\* Strong understanding of MES concepts, including:

\* Workflows and production operations

\* Dispatching and scheduling

\* Material and lot traceability

\* Electronic work instructions

\* Quality and nonconformance management

\* Equipment and labor tracking

\* Genealogy and reporting

\* Experience with software design, application development, system configuration, and integration.

\* Strong SQL and relational database development experience.

\* Experience developing or consuming APIs, web services, and system interfaces.

\* Knowledge of application development using technologies such as .NET, Java, JavaScript, or similar.

\* Experience with software development lifecycle, testing, deployment, and production support.

\* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and communication skills.

\* Ability to work effectively with global and cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Qualifications**

\* Experience integrating Opcenter MES with ERP systems

\* Experience with REST APIs, message brokers, middleware, and event-driven architectures.

\* Knowledge of cloud platforms, DevOps, CI/CD, Git, and automated testing.

\* Experience supporting semiconductor, optical, electronics, or discrete manufacturing.

\* Experience with digital twin, Industry 4.0, or smart factory initiatives.

\* Siemens Opcenter certification or relevant professional certification.

**Key Competencies**

\* MES solution design and architecture

\* Opcenter configuration and development

\* Manufacturing process analysis

\* System integration

\* Database and API development

\* Problem solving and root-cause analysis

\* Stakeholder management

\* Technical documentation

\* Agile project delivery

**Scope of Work**

1. Business Requirements Gathering

\* Engage with business stakeholders, production teams, quality, maintenance, warehouse, and IT teams to understand current manufacturing processes.

\* Conduct workshops, interviews, and site visits to gather functional and non-functional requirements.

\* Document business requirements and obtain stakeholder approval.

2. Process Analysis and Documentation

\* Analyze existing ("As-Is") manufacturing processes and identify pain points and improvement opportunities.

\* Design future-state ("To-Be") processes aligned with MES capabilities and business objectives.

\* Develop process maps, workflow diagrams, and business process documentation.

3. Requirements Management

\* Create and maintain Business Requirements Documents (BRD), Functional Requirements Specifications (FRS), user stories, and acceptance criteria.

\* Prioritize requirements based on business value, regulatory compliance, and project scope.

\* Manage requirement traceability throughout the project lifecycle.

4. Gap Analysis

\* Compare current business processes with standard MES functionality.

\* Identify functional gaps and recommend process changes, system configuration, or customizations where necessary.

\* Evaluate impacts on manufacturing operations and business processes.

5. Stakeholder Management

\* Act as the primary liaison between business users, implementation partners, solution architects, developers, and project management.

\* Facilitate discussions to resolve business and functional issues.

\* Ensure stakeholder expectations are aligned throughout the implementation.

6. Functional Solution Design

\* Collaborate with solution architects to translate business requirements into functional solutions.

\* Review system configurations to ensure alignment with approved business requirements.

\* Support the definition of workflows, business rules, and exception handling.

7. Integration Requirements

\* Define business requirements for integrations between MES and enterprise systems such as ERP, SCADA, PLCs, LIMS, WMS, and quality systems.

\* Work with integration teams to validate end-to-end business processes.

\* Ensure data consistency and process continuity across integrated systems.

8. Master Data Management

\* Identify manufacturing master data requirements, including products, materials, equipment, routing, work centers, recipes, and resources.

\* Support data mapping, validation, and migration activities.

\* Ensure data quality and governance standards are followed.

9. Testing Support

\* Develop test scenarios and business test cases.

\* Support System Integration Testing (SIT), User Acceptance Testing (UAT), and production validation.

\* Coordinate defect triage with business users and technical teams.

\* Validate that implemented functionality meets business requirements.

10. Change Management and Training

\* Assess business impacts resulting from new MES processes.

\* Prepare training materials, user guides, and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

\* Conduct user training sessions and support organizational change management initiatives.

11. Deployment and Go-Live Support

\* Assist in deployment planning and production readiness assessments.

\* Support cutover activities and business validation during go-live.

\* Monitor user adoption and provide functional support during hypercare.

12. Risk and Issue Management

\* Identify business risks associated with MES implementation.

\* Escalate issues affecting project scope, timeline, or operational readiness.

\* Recommend mitigation strategies and participate in issue resolution.

13. Compliance and Quality Assurance

\* Ensure MES processes comply with industry regulations, company standards, and quality requirements.

\* Support audit readiness by maintaining complete and accurate business documentation.

\* Verify that electronic records and manufacturing workflows meet applicable compliance requirements.

14. Continuous Improvement

\* Collect user feedback after implementation.

\* Identify opportunities for process optimization and system enhancements.

\* Support future MES releases, upgrades, and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Key Deliverables**

\* Business Requirements Document (MD50)

\* Technical Requirements Specification (MD70)

\* As-Is and To-Be Process Maps

\* Gap Analysis Report

\* Data Mapping Documents

\* Test Scenarios and UAT Scripts

\* Training Materials and SOPs

\* Business Process Documentation

\* Go-Live Readiness Checklist

description:
**Join the Team That's Redefining Wireless Technology**

At Tarana, we're more than just a fast-growing tech company—we’re a team of bold innovators on a mission to revolutionize broadband. Our groundbreaking Fixed Wireless Access technology is delivering fiber-class internet speeds worldwide, bridging the digital divide in ways previously thought impossible.

We are seeking an experienced Staff Software Engineer - Networking. This role involves technical ownership, hands-on design, and active participation across different stages of network and cloud software development. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of networking, software development best practices, and a passion for driving innovation. Experience shipping working products in the networking/telecom/embedded domain is essential.

We don’t just build next-gen wireless technology—we build people.

**What You'll Be Doing**

You will be designing, developing, and integrating critical elements for the network stack of our wireless communication systems, including data plane, control plane, security, and remote/cloud management:

* **Data Plane & Packet Processing:** Design and implement Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking features, packet forwarding, routing, bridging, switching, VLAN architectures, traffic management/classification, and SLA enforcement.
* **Hardware & Device Interfacing:** Implement software interfaces for underlying hardware devices (ASIC/FPGA), switch management, configuration engines, alarms, diagnostics, and WebUI/CLI backends.
* **Security & Network Services:** Build network security services, including authentication, encryption, encapsulation, and tunneling (e.g., IPSec, CAPWAP, 802.1x).
* **Frameworks & Telemetry:** Implement scalable network and cloud management frameworks for device provisioning, event logging, telemetry collection, and automated fault isolation/analysis.
* **System Resilience:** Design decentralized network services with a focus on scalability, resilience, high availability, and interoperability with customer networks.

**What You'll Need**

* B.E./B.Tech./M.E./M.Tech./MS in Computer Science/Engineering with at least 12+ years of relevant software development experience, OR MS/PhD with at least 9+ years of relevant experience.
* Strong experience in socket, network, and systems programming using C or C++ on UNIX-style operating systems (IPC, multi-threading).
* Advanced knowledge of computer networks (TCP/IP), Internet architecture, and core protocols (e.g., IGMP, DHCP, OSPF, BGP).
* Expertise in packet forwarding, routing, bridging, switching, VLANs, Ethernet services, and Ethernet OA&M.
* Familiarity with network/cloud management and configuration/provisioning systems (e.g., YANG Models, gRPC, NETCONF, SNMP, TR-69, HTTP, OpenFlow).
* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, with a proven ability to drive complex issues to closure.
* Previous experience in embedded software development for carrier and/or enterprise telecom products is a big plus.

**Nice to Have**

* Strong C++ or Go programming experience; proficiency with scripting languages (Python, Bash).
* Experience using AI tools/agents across the software development lifecycle (from requirements analysis to field debugging).
* Background in MAC or network-layer implementations of 802.11, LTE, or other OFDM wireless standards.

**Join Tarana and help shape the future of wireless connectivity.**

**About Us**

Tarana’s mission is to accelerate the deployment of fast, affordable, and reliable internet access around the world. Through a decade of R&D and over $400M of investment, the Tarana team has created and continues to enhance a suite of next-generation fixed wireless access (ngFWA) technologies. Its unique ngFWA platform delivers game-changing advances in broadband economics in mainstream and underserved markets, using both licensed and unlicensed spectrum. Tarana’s ngFWA technology has been embraced by more than 300 service providers in 24 countries. Tarana is headquartered in Milpitas, California, with additional research and development in Pune, India. Learn more at www.taranawireless.com.

title: Senior Software Engineer - Networking
description:
**Join the Team That's Redefining Wireless Technology**

At Tarana, we're more than just a fast-growing tech company—we’re a team of bold innovators on a mission to revolutionize broadband. Our groundbreaking Fixed Wireless Access technology is delivering fiber-class internet speeds worldwide, bridging the digital divide in ways previously thought impossible.

We are seeking an experienced Senior Software Engineer - Networking. This role involves technical ownership, hands-on design, and active participation across different stages of network and cloud software development. The ideal candidate will have a deep understanding of networking, software development best practices, and a passion for driving innovation. Experience shipping working products in the networking/telecom/embedded domain is essential.

We don’t just build next-gen wireless technology—we build people.

**What You'll Be Doing**

You will be designing, developing, and integrating critical elements for the network stack of our wireless communication systems, including data plane, control plane, security, and remote/cloud management:

* **Data Plane & Packet Processing:** Design and implement Layer 2 and Layer 3 networking features, packet forwarding, routing, bridging, switching, VLAN architectures, traffic management/classification, and SLA enforcement.
* **Hardware & Device Interfacing:** Implement software interfaces for underlying hardware devices (ASIC/FPGA), switch management, configuration engines, alarms, diagnostics, and WebUI/CLI backends.
* **Security & Network Services:** Build network security services, including authentication, encryption, encapsulation, and tunneling (e.g., IPSec, CAPWAP, 802.1x).
* **Frameworks & Telemetry:** Implement scalable network and cloud management frameworks for device provisioning, event logging, telemetry collection, and automated fault isolation/analysis.
* **System Resilience:** Design decentralized network services with a focus on scalability, resilience, high availability, and interoperability with customer networks.

**What You'll Need**

* B.E./B.Tech./M.E./M.Tech./MS in Computer Science/Engineering with at least 7+ years of relevant software development experience, OR MS/PhD with at least 5+ years of relevant experience.
* Strong experience in socket, network, and systems programming using C or C++ on UNIX-style operating systems (IPC, multi-threading).
* Advanced knowledge of computer networks (TCP/IP), Internet architecture, and core protocols (e.g., IGMP, DHCP, OSPF, BGP).
* Expertise in packet forwarding, routing, bridging, switching, VLANs, Ethernet services, and Ethernet OA&M.
* Familiarity with network/cloud management and configuration/provisioning systems (e.g., YANG Models, gRPC, NETCONF, SNMP, TR-69, HTTP, OpenFlow).
* Strong debugging and problem-solving skills, with a proven ability to drive complex issues to closure.
* Previous experience in embedded software development for carrier and/or enterprise telecom products is a big plus.

**Nice to Have**

* Strong C++ or Go programming experience; proficiency with scripting languages (Python, Bash).
* Experience using AI tools/agents across the software development lifecycle (from requirements analysis to field debugging).
* Background in MAC or network-layer implementations of 802.11, LTE, or other OFDM wireless standards.

**Join Tarana and help shape the future of wireless connectivity.**

**About Us**

Tarana’s mission is to accelerate the deployment of fast, affordable, and reliable internet access around the world. Through a decade of R&D and over $400M of investment, the Tarana team has created and continues to enhance a suite of next-generation fixed wireless access (ngFWA) technologies. Its unique ngFWA platform delivers game-changing advances in broadband economics in mainstream and underserved markets, using both licensed and unlicensed spectrum. Tarana’s ngFWA technology has been embraced by more than 300 service providers in 24 countries. Tarana is headquartered in Milpitas, California, with additional research and development in Pune, India. Learn more at www.taranawireless.com.

* Providing standard and ad-hoc payroll reports as needed by various internal departments such as Finance, Accounting, Legal, Benefits, and People Operations.

* Providing support in various system implementation projects as needed.
* Provide support to external and internal audits for the area of payroll

* 5 to 10 years of relevant and progressive payroll experience; **public company payroll experience required**
