Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*

**Title and Summary**


Senior Software Engineer
Job Description Summary  

Overview  

Mastercard® Global Data Repository—a leading technology repository that houses enhanced information (daily transactions from MasterCard issuers plus data from vendors such as airlines and hotels). GDR powers multiple Mastercard commercial products and provides enriched data to Mastercard smartdata. gen2, a scalable, global, web\-based solution of payment data and information management.  

  

Global Data Repository (GDR) maintains data in a highly secure environment behind multiple firewalls; it collects detailed data from many different sources and aggregates it into a single common format for distribution to various entities. It distributes data globally daily to issuers and their customers via Smart Data solutions, or directly to those customers using their own MIS or ERP system.  

  

* The Applications Development Team is a dedicated collection of self\-organizing, interdependent, and highly efficient co\-located individuals. There are multiple teams as part of SmartData GDR, spread over (Pune) India and (St. Louis) USA.
* Team members may be developers, testers, analysts, architects, project managers and product owners. The team is cross\-functional, and follows the agile SAFE methods to deliver the work

  

Role  

We are seeking a versatile Sr. Software Development Engineer who can bridge the gap between development and quality assurance using methodologies, tools, strategies, and standards based on best practices in Agile software development/quality and continuous integration and deployment. Proficient in full\-stack development and building robust automated testing frameworks from scratch. Adept at driving shift\-left testing methodologies, reducing deployment risks, and accelerating CI/CD pipelines to deliver high\-quality software.  

  

Role  

* Coordinate and participate in business requirements review/story elaborations and testing activities to deliver high\-quality products and incremental value with every iteration.
* Collaborate across teams as a dual\-hat engineer, participating in code reviews, architectural design, and writing comprehensive test plans.
* Review project test and implementation schedules. Document test plans and acceptance criteria using JIRA, Rally or such solution life cycle management tools.
* Participate \& contribute to requirement elaboration sessions, design the solution, point the stories and deliver them within the iteration
* Develop and perform automated and manual exploratory testing to ensure software meets business and security requirements and established best practices.
* Own responsibility for end\-to\-end product development and quality including defect management and oversight, status reporting and metrics creation, and escalation for issues discovered during the quality assessment phase.
* Develop business and product knowledge over time and share such knowledge to mentor newer team members. This is not a management position; however, this position is expected to provide strong leadership to junior members of the staff.


All About You  

* A record of successful delivery of large software applications as Senior developer. Expertise of agile methodologies and tools such as JIRA, RALLY, SQL and Oracle Database, Rational Team Concert, Quality Center, etc.
* Experience in both Unit and Integration testing needs with exposure to data virtualization tools. Additional knowledge of Unix and shell scripting will be preferred.
* Expertise in software development to build and use automation frameworks using technologies: Java, Spring, JUnit, Selenium, JBehave, Soap UI/Pro, REST, JSON and XML, Eclipse IDE.
* Good understanding of technical solution and software patterns (including architectural \& design patterns) at various levels.
* Demonstrated experience developing high\-quality strategies and execution – specific focus on cross browser and cross device testing.
* Ability to create good acceptance and integration test automation scripts and integrate with Continuous integration (Jenkins/Bamboo) and code coverage tools (Sonar, Clover) to ensure 80% or higher code coverage.
* Exposure to product ssdelivery, performance engineering and profiling (e.g. Java JVM, Databases) and tools such as Load Runner and JMeter desirable.
* Strong organizational and problem\-solving skills with great attention to detail, critical thinking, solid communication and proven leadership skills \- with the ability to lead multiple test paths simultaneously.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**

  

All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

We are looking for a **Web Developer Fresher** who is interested in building and managing websites and wants to develop strong practical skills in e\-commerce, web development and SEO.

You don't need extensive experience in Shopify or WordPress. **Basic training on both platforms will be provided.**

However, you should have a good understanding of **web development fundamentals, coding and basic technical concepts**. We are looking for someone who understands how a website works, not just someone who knows how to edit content.

* Publish and format articles/blog posts

* Optimise headings and URLs
* Add and optimise image alt text

* Has a strong interest in web development

title: Java Developer
description:
**Discover your future at Citi**
--------------------------------


Working at Citi is far more than just a job. A career with us means joining a team of approximately 219,000 dedicated people from around the globe. At Citi, you’ll have the opportunity to grow your career, give back to your community and make a real impact.


**Job Overview**
----------------


Citi is looking for a Java Developer to join the Equity Derivatives Trade Management team in Pune, building high\-performing, enterprise\-grade applications that directly reduce operational risk and support business growth across global markets. In this role, you will collaborate with front office, operations, and product development teams to design and deliver scalable backend solutions that shape the future technical direction of high\-profile trading platforms. This is an opportunity to take meaningful ownership of functional components and make a measurable impact across teams at one of the world's leading financial institutions.


**Responsibilities**


* Design and develop scalable, enterprise\-grade Java backend applications that improve operational efficiency and reduce risk across the Equity Derivatives business.
* Build and maintain solutions spanning the full software development lifecycle, from requirements gathering and technical design through to deployment and ongoing support.
* Translate business and client requirements into well\-structured technical designs, providing effort estimates and clearly communicating delivery approach.
* Conduct code reviews and test case reviews to ensure delivered software meets functional requirements and quality standards.
* Identify and proactively communicate delivery risks with sufficient lead time to protect project outcomes.
* Collaborate with front office, operations, and product teams to understand needs and propose technically sound solutions that serve clients effectively.
* Apply expertise in systems analysis and component\-level design, coding, unit testing, and debugging to deliver reliable, production\-ready software.

  

**Required Qualifications \& Skills**


* 5 to 8 years of hands\-on experience developing backend applications in Core Java (version 1\.7 or above) within an enterprise environment.
* Solid command of object\-oriented programming principles, applied consistently to produce maintainable and extensible code.
* Working knowledge of SQL, with the ability to write and interpret queries in support of application data requirements.
* Experience integrating with at least one messaging middleware platform such as Tibco EMS, Solace, or IBM MQ.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently and take ownership of deliverables with minimal supervision in a fast\-paced, project\-driven environment.
* Track record of contributing across the full software development lifecycle, including requirements analysis, technical design, coding, testing, and delivery.
* Beneficial Skills \& Qualifications
* Familiarity with HTML5 and React.js, enabling contribution to front\-end integration work where required.
* Experience working within capital markets, trading, or financial services technology teams, with exposure to equity derivatives or similar product areas.
* Exposure to agile delivery environments, with the ability to adapt to evolving project requirements and shifting priorities.

**What We Offer**


* Joining Citi's Equity Derivatives Trade Management team in Pune means working on technically complex, high\-profile platforms where your contributions directly influence the quality and direction of systems used across global markets. You will work alongside driven, experienced engineers in a collaborative, performance\-focused environment built on trust and mutual respect.
* Hybrid working model with 3 days in the office and 2 days working remotely, giving you structure alongside genuine flexibility.
* Autonomy to take ownership of functional components and influence the technical direction of enterprise\-scale applications.
* Exposure to complex financial technology in the equity derivatives space, broadening your experience in high\-impact engineering domains.
* Access to learning and development opportunities that support continued technical growth and career progression.
* A collaborative team environment where creative problem\-solving and engineering excellence are actively encouraged.
* The scale and reach of a global financial institution, with the opportunity to see your work affect real outcomes for clients worldwide.
